repository.orgName: Nani Khakhar Gnan Mandir (Pārśvacandra-gaccha), Nani Khakhar, Kutch, Gujarat

summary.p: Single-text manuscript of the Joga Batrīsī of Pārśvacandra, here titled Yogabatrīsī in the rubric and Ātmajñāna-dvātriṃśikā in the completion statement. 33 verses: the 32 verses of witness A (AKGM 145480, Koba) and an additional closing verse with the author's signature (śrī pāsacaṃda ima vīnavaï). Undated; copied by ṛṣi Karmasī. Witness N of the edition.

Described from three photographs taken by Muni Bhuvanacandra in March 2026 (f. 1r, 1v, 2r); f. 2v not photographed. Published with his written permission (letter of October 2026). Measurements and higher-resolution images to follow.

support.p: Paper, browned, with worn edges; small losses at the upper left corner of f. 1r.

extent.measure: 2 folios (f. 2v not photographed, presumably blank). Measurements to follow; the photographs carry no scale.

supportDesc.foliation: Nāgarī folio number 1 in the right margin of f. 1v, by the scribe.

collation.desc: 2 folios = Text. Foliated 1. Text on f. 1r (13 lines), f. 1v (13 lines) and f. 2r (9 lines, ending with the colophon).

supportDesc.condition: Legible throughout; ink somewhat faded on f. 2r; offset of writing from a facing leaf at the lower right of f. 2r.

layoutDesc.layout: 13 lines per page (f. 2r: 9). Triple ruled margins in black ink on both sides. A blank lozenge in the centre of each page (lines 5–9 on f. 1r and 1v, lines 4–8 on f. 2r) imitates a string-hole space; no actual hole.

handNote.desc: Jaina nāgarī, a single cursive hand, less regular than that of witness A. Verse numbers written in the line without daṇḍas. ??? pṛṣṭhamātrā / ba–va distinction to be checked on the images.

additions.desc: Folio number 1 in the right margin of f. 1v.

origin.origDate: Undated. The hand and the modernised language (Sanskritised vocabulary, -o for -aü) suggest a date later than witness A (1627); ??? to be assessed.
origin.origPlace: Unknown; presumably Gujarat or Kutch. Scribe: ṛṣi Karmasī.

provenance.p: Collection of the Pārśvacandra-gaccha at Nani Khakhar (Kutch), where the manuscripts of Pārśvacandra's works are kept. ???

acquisition.p: Photographs (3 JPEG, 1280 × 603 px, phone camera) received from Muni Bhuvanacandra, head of the Pārśvacandra-gaccha, in March 2026, through Dr Shrinetra Pandey (ISJS Pune). Permission to publish them granted by him in writing, October 2026.

listBibl.bibl: Lhoir, Corinna May. forthcoming. "The Joga Baṭrīsī: Vernacular Jain Yoga and the Reordering of Aṣṭāṅga Yoga." (Chapter IV of the cumulative dissertation, with critical edition.)

encodingDesc.p: Diplomatic transcription in IAST following the TST conventions; the Devanāgarī view is generated from it. Independent vowels after a vowel (vowel hiatus, e.g. lābhaï = लाभइ) are written with diaeresis (ï, ü), as distinct from the diphthongs ai/au. Line breaks of the manuscript are marked with lb; the blank central lozenge is not marked. Spaces added between words where possible. Verse numbers as in the manuscript (without daṇḍas; the daṇḍas of the transcription mark the half-verses and are editorial). Anusvāra as written (ṃ). The opening sign is encoded as the bhale symbol (g ref="#bhale"); the scribe's form to be compared with the TST sign list. Language of the verses: Old Gujarati / Maru-Gurjar, tagged provisionally as gu; rubric and colophon in Sanskrit, tagged sa.

revisionDesc.change: First version: description and transcription of f. 1r–2r in IAST from the Devanāgarī transcription (Corinna May Lhoir, with Claude); line breaks read from the photographs, to be verified. IIIF manifest from archive.org.
